description: Use when the user wants what people say about an app - complaints, bugs, feature requests, competitor research - e.g. "recent 1- and 2-star reviews of WhatsApp in the UK App Store". Returns the reviews shown on the store page (about 10 per App Store country, 20 per Google Play language) with rating, title, text, date, app version, thumbs-up and developer reply (Google Play). Filter with rating=[1,2], sort and country; page with offset. For ratings and metadata use get_app.

id.description: App Store id, package name or store URL.

name: list_app_reviews
title: Read App Store / Google Play reviews (complaints, feature requests)
